question: Should OpenClaw own durable marketplace-watch history in the global shared-state schema, including the v4 migration and its upgrade/downgrade contract?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit user discussion and acceptance before an agent advances the SQLite schema version, and the PR discussion supplied here does not establish that decision.

options.title: Pause for state-owner acceptance
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge the v4 migration until the core owner explicitly accepts the persistent-state scope and upgrade contract.

options.title: Move watch state to an owner boundary
options.body: Rework the feature so optional marketplace-watch persistence is owned by a plugin or other dedicated owner instead of the global core schema.

recommendation.title: Pause for state-owner acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge the v4 migration until the core owner explicitly accepts the persistent-state scope and upgrade contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core product and persistent-state contract decision rather than a mechanical implementation choice.
